statement.ru: Зёрна пшеницы из египетских гробниц прорастают даже через 3000 лет.
statement.en: Wheat grains from Egyptian tombs still sprout after 3,000 years.

why: 'Mummy wheat' is a 19th-century myth; tests found no germination.

statement.ru: Некоторые грибы светятся в темноте.
statement.en: Some mushrooms glow in the dark.

why: Wikipedia (Fungus): more than one hundred fungal species display bioluminescence.

statement.ru: Перекати-поле катится по степи в поисках воды.
statement.en: A tumbleweed rolls across the plains in search of water.

why: It is a dry, detached plant rolled by the wind to scatter its seeds.

statement.ru: Грибы, как и растения, питаются солнечным светом.
statement.en: Fungi, like plants, feed on sunlight.

why: Fungi do not photosynthesise; they digest and absorb food.

statement.ru: Агар-агар для мармелада делают из грибов.
statement.en: Agar for jelly sweets is made from mushrooms.

why: Agar comes from the cell walls of red algae (seaweed).

statement.ru: Учёные оживили мох, пролежавший во льдах Антарктиды 1500 лет.
statement.en: Scientists revived moss that had lain frozen in Antarctica for 1,500 years.

why: 2014 study: moss from Signy Island permafrost, over 1,500 years old, regrew.

statement.ru: Дикие кактусы растут только в жарких пустынях.
statement.en: Wild cacti grow only in hot deserts.

why: Cacti range north to western Canada and also grow as climbers and epiphytes in tropical forests.

statement.ru: Семена орхидеи размером с горошину.
statement.en: Orchid seeds are the size of a pea.

why: Orchid seeds are almost microscopic and blow away like dust.

statement.ru: Лишайник — это союз гриба и водоросли.
statement.en: A lichen is a partnership of a fungus and an alga.

why: Algae or cyanobacteria live among fungal filaments in a symbiosis.

statement.ru: Грибы ближе по родству к животным, чем к растениям.
statement.en: Fungi are more closely related to animals than to plants.

why: Fungi are genetically closer to animals than to plants.

statement.ru: Венерина мухоловка родом всего из двух штатов США.
statement.en: The Venus flytrap is native to only two US states.

why: Native only to the wetlands of North and South Carolina (small introduced populations elsewhere).

statement.ru: Газонная трава растёт от кончиков листьев.
statement.en: Lawn grass grows from the tips of its blades.

why: Grass blades grow from the base, which is why grass survives mowing and grazing.

statement.ru: Гигантская бурая водоросль может вырасти за день на полметра.
statement.en: Giant kelp can grow half a metre in a single day.

why: Giant kelp grows up to 60 cm per day.

statement.ru: Один-единственный гриб в США раскинулся под землёй почти на 10 км².
statement.en: A single fungus in the USA spreads underground over nearly 10 square kilometres.

why: The Oregon honey fungus covers about 9.1 km² (some sources 9.6).

statement.ru: Корень мандрагоры кричит, когда его выдёргивают из земли.
statement.en: A mandrake root screams when it is pulled out of the ground.

why: The scream is an old superstition (Gerard's Herball, 1597), not a real property.

statement.ru: Ядовитый плющ — родственник кешью.
statement.en: Poison ivy is a relative of the cashew.

why: Poison ivy is not a true ivy but a member of the cashew family, Anacardiaceae.

statement.ru: Самое большое семя на свете весит больше 10 кг.
statement.en: The biggest seed in the world weighs more than 10 kg.

why: The coco de mer seed weighs 10 to 25 kg, the heaviest in the plant kingdom.

statement.ru: Мухоморами раньше травили мух — их крошили в молоко.
statement.en: People once killed flies with fly agaric crumbled into milk.

why: Albertus Magnus: 'called the fly mushroom because it is powdered in milk to kill flies'.

statement.ru: Ягоды, которые едят птицы, безопасны и для человека.
statement.en: Berries that birds eat are safe for people too.

why: Birds eat poison ivy berries freely, but the plant's urushiol harms humans.

statement.ru: Муравьи разносят семена растений, утаскивая их в муравейник.
statement.en: Ants spread plant seeds by carrying them into their nest.

why: Many seeds carry a food body that lures ants to haul them home.

statement.ru: Плод «бешеного огурца» выстреливает семенами на несколько метров.
statement.en: The squirting cucumber shoots its seeds several metres.

why: Oxford 2024 study: seeds land up to about 10 m away (250 times the fruit length).

statement.ru: Колючки кактуса — это видоизменённые листья.
statement.en: A cactus's spines are modified leaves.

why: Wikipedia: cactus spines are modified leaves.

statement.ru: Мох на деревьях растёт только с северной стороны.
statement.en: Moss grows only on the north side of trees.

why: Moss grows wherever it is damp and shady, on any side.

statement.ru: Ядовитый гриб можно узнать по неприятному вкусу.
statement.en: You can tell a poisonous mushroom by its bad taste.

why: Survivors of deadly Amanita poisoning said the mushrooms tasted quite good.

statement.ru: Кувшин хищного непентеса бывает таким большим, что в него попадают крысы.
statement.en: A carnivorous pitcher plant's pitcher can be big enough to trap rats.

why: Nepenthes rajah can trap mammals as large as rats.

statement.ru: Нашествие кактусов в Австралии остановили гусеницы бабочки.
statement.en: An invasion of cacti in Australia was stopped by moth caterpillars.

why: The cactus moth, brought in 1925, brought invasive prickly pear under control.

statement.ru: Некоторым семенам, чтобы прорасти, нужен лесной пожар.
statement.en: Some seeds need a wildfire to sprout.

why: Heat, smoke or charred wood trigger germination in fire-adapted plants.

statement.ru: Венерина мухоловка ловит в основном мух.
statement.en: A Venus flytrap mostly catches flies.

why: Its prey is mostly ants (33%) and spiders (30%); flying insects are under 5%.

statement.ru: Некоторые виды бамбука цветут раз в сто с лишним лет.
statement.en: Some kinds of bamboo flower only once in over a hundred years.

why: Phyllostachys bambusoides flowers every 120 years, all plants at once.

statement.ru: Учёные вырастили финиковую пальму из семечка возрастом 2000 лет.
statement.en: Scientists grew a date palm from a 2,000-year-old seed.

why: The 'Methuselah' seed from Masada, dated 155 BC to 64 AD, sprouted in 2005.

statement.ru: Волоски крапивы работают как шприц: кончик обламывается и впрыскивает яд.
statement.en: Nettle hairs work like a syringe: the tip snaps off and injects the sting.

why: The hair tips break off on contact and act like hypodermic needles.

statement.ru: Кактус возле компьютера защищает от излучения монитора.
statement.en: A cactus next to a computer protects you from the monitor's radiation.

why: A 2018 test found cacti had no effect on a monitor's fields.

statement.ru: Листья пустынной вельвичии растут всю её жизнь — сотни лет.
statement.en: The leaves of the desert welwitschia keep growing all its life, for hundreds of years.

why: Its leaves grow continuously from the crown and last the plant's entire life.

statement.ru: Если в отвар попал ядовитый гриб, серебряная ложка потемнеет.
statement.en: If a poisonous mushroom gets into a broth, a silver spoon turns dark.

why: Folk myth: none of the known mushroom toxins react with silver.

statement.ru: Дикий бамбук растёт только в Азии.
statement.en: Wild bamboo grows only in Asia.

why: Bamboo is also native to the Americas, sub-Saharan Africa and northern Australia.

statement.ru: Хищные растения растут только в тропиках.
statement.en: Carnivorous plants grow only in the tropics.

why: They grow on every continent except Antarctica, including temperate bogs.

statement.ru: Есть растение, которое годами лежит сухим шариком, а в воде за часы раскрывается.
statement.en: There is a plant that lies dry as a ball for years and opens up in water within hours.

why: The resurrection plant survives years of drought and uncurls within hours of watering.

statement.ru: В Первую мировую мох сфагнум прикладывали к ранам вместо ваты.
statement.en: In the First World War, sphagnum moss was used on wounds instead of cotton.

why: Sphagnum was used as a first-aid dressing on soldiers' wounds in WWI.

statement.ru: Кокос может переплыть по морю на другой остров и прорасти там.
statement.en: A coconut can float across the sea to another island and sprout there.

why: The coconut fruit is buoyant and adapted for ocean dispersal.
